title: Delivery & Release Coordinator (UAT and Quality) - IFS Logistics
description:
**Company Description**

Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics is an AI enterprise logistics platform that helps shippers and logistics businesses connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. Originally launched as 7bridges, the product is now part of IFS and is developed by a small, dedicated team.

**The role**

We are looking for a Delivery & Release Coordinator to manage user acceptance testing, release activity and day-to-day delivery coordination across the product team.

The team is preparing for its first IFS Cloud customer go-live, bringing a new API into production and recruiting a significant number of new colleagues. As the pace of delivery increases, we need clear ownership of test cycles, defects, release readiness and communication.

You will coordinate UAT with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain release plans and checklists, track defects through to resolution and support go/no-go decisions. You will work closely with Lorraine Hassall, our Quality Manager, allowing her to focus on quality standards and strategy while you manage the practical coordination required to apply them consistently.

Most of the role is focused on UAT, releases and delivery. It also includes a smaller amount of team coordination, particularly onboarding, in-person sessions, travel planning, and financial coordination.

**What you'll work on**

**UAT and release management**

* Plan and coordinate UAT cycles with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Confirm scope, participants, test windows, evidence and sign-off for each cycle.
* Track defects from identification through triage, ownership, resolution and closure.
* Support on the release calendar, release notes, readiness checklist and go/no-go process.
* Coordinate with other teams in IFS as the product is integrated with IFS Cloud.
* Support the UAT and release plan for Project Oliver and the first IFS Cloud customer go-live.

**Supporting the quality function**

* Work with the Quality Manager on test processes, evidence and audit trails.
* Help apply standards such as clear acceptance criteria, merge-request review and controlled production releases.
* Support the move from periodic manual QA towards per-ticket quality assurance and more frequent releases.

**Delivery coordination**

* Keep Jira accurate, with current statuses, acceptance criteria and links to relevant merge requests.
* Maintain useful documentation and decision records in Notion.
* Prepare concise delivery and release updates for product and engineering leads.
* Identify risks early, clarify ownership and follow actions through to completion.

**Team coordination**

* Organise onboarding logistics for new starters and monthly in-person sessions in Staines.
* Coordinate team travel, expenses and purchase orders.

 **Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Strong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of identifying and addressing issues early.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* The ability to work constructively with engineers and maintain agreed standards when priorities are competing.
* A practical, accountable approach to moving work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
* Experience coordinating UAT, software releases or delivery within a product or engineering team.
* Familiarity with release notes, test cycles, defect tracking, go/no-go decisions, acceptance criteria and regression scope.
* Experience managing a defect list through triage and resolution rather than only reporting its status.
* Confidence using Jira and a documentation platform such as Notion or Confluence.

Relevant backgrounds may include delivery coordination, release coordination, junior delivery management, QA coordination, scrum mastery or project coordination. We are more interested in what you have managed than in your previous job title.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with enterprise software involving customer UAT and formal sign-off.
* Exposure to regulated or audited environments, ERP products or supply-chain software.
* ISTQB, Agile or delivery certification.
* Experience working within a large organisation with established procurement and HR processes.
* Experience using AI tools to draft release notes, summarise defect lists or prepare status updates.

**Tools**

The team uses Jira, Notion, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, along with IFS systems for travel, expenses and purchasing. You do not need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with engineers and understanding their delivery processes.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* Releases follow a predictable cadence and include clear, accurate release notes.
* Each UAT cycle has an agreed owner, schedule, defect list, evidence and sign-off.
* Customer and support defects receive clear ownership and a visible route to resolution.
* The Project Oliver go-live is supported by a well-managed UAT and release plan.
* Acceptance criteria, review and release controls are applied consistently.
* Product and engineering leads spend less time on routine coordination and administration.

**Why we're hiring now**

The product team is growing and preparing for several important releases. The Quality Manager currently carries much of the practical coordination associated with testing and releases. This role will provide dedicated support of that work, helping the team increase delivery frequency while maintaining clear quality and release controls.

 **Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Piping Engineer Level I
description:
**Description - Internal**

**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**The Role**

***As a Piping Engineer with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience.

* Piping Design & Layout Engineering:
  + Develop piping layouts for mining, mineral processing, and metal extraction facilities based on P&IDs, process flow diagrams (PFDs), and client specifications.
  + Ensure the layout design optimizes space, operational efficiency, and ease of installation while meeting industry safety and environmental standards.
  + Prepare detailed piping design drawings, including routing, support placement, and equipment integration.
  + Coordinate the layout of piping systems with other engineering disciplines such as civil, mechanical, and electrical to ensure seamless integration.
  + Select appropriate materials for piping systems based on factors such as fluid type, temperature, pressure, and environmental conditions.
* FEED (Front-End Engineering Design):
  + Participate in the FEED phase of projects, assisting in the development of piping layouts and preliminary designs
  + Work with multidisciplinary teams to define project scope, estimate costs, and identify potential design challenges.
  + Review client specifications and ensure the design aligns with technical, budgetary, and scheduling requirements.
  + Contribute to the development of initial piping design concepts, material take-offs, and cost estimates.
* Detailed Engineering Design:
  + Prepare detailed engineering designs for the full scope of piping systems, including pipe sizes, materials, valves, and fittings, as well as system integration.
  + Use S3D, E3D, AutoCAD, Microstation, Plant 3D, or similar CAD software to develop accurate piping design drawings and layouts.
  + Coordinate with the stress analysis team to address any piping support and stress-related issues.
  + Ensure that all piping designs comply with applicable industry standards and codes (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, etc.).
* Layout Optimization:
  + Optimize piping layout designs for both new projects and modifications to existing plants by minimizing material usage, reducing installation time, and enhancing operational efficiency.
  + Review existing designs to identify potential areas for improvement and ensure that the piping layout adheres to best practices and operational needs.
* Coordination & Communication:
  + Work closely with internal teams, clients, contractors, and vendors to ensure the timely and successful completion of projects.
  + Participate in 3D design reviews, safety meetings, and project coordination meetings to track progress and mitigate risks.
  + Maintain clear and consistent communication regarding project milestones, design changes, and any potential challenges.
* Quality Control & Compliance:
  + Ensure the piping design meets quality standards and safety regulations in accordance with project requirements, local regulations, and industry codes.
  + Perform thorough checks to confirm design accuracy, material selection, and compliance with specifications.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in piping design, layout engineering, and detailed engineering in the mining, mineral, and metal industries or related heavy industries.
* Proficient in S3D, E3D, AutoCAD, Microstation, Plant 3D, or similar 3D CAD software used for piping design.
* In-depth knowledge of piping codes and standards (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, ISO) and the ability to apply them effectively in design.
* Experience in FEED and detailed design phases of projects, from initial concept to final design.
* Familiarity with stress analysis and material selection for various operating conditions (pressure, temperature, and corrosion resistance).
* Strong understanding of piping layout principles, including routing, spacing, support design, and integration with equipment and structures.
* Experience working on large-scale mining or metallurgical plant projects.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and coordination skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Purpose:**  

We are currently recruiting for a Principal Mining Engineer. Our team includes world class experts and dynamic go\-getters. This is a full\-time position based in Oakville or Markham, Ontario to support the delivery of successful projects and programs with the Worley Canadian Mining Team. The successful candidates will focus on front\-end solutions and will support of Worley’s engineering projects both locally and globally.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical and consulting services to mining clients.
* Act as Mining lead, Project Manager, Project Engineer on EPCM and DE and Project Delivery scope/projects.
* Providing input into Business Development strategy and expand professional network.
* Leading, managing and directing technical and engineering work on PEA, PFS, and FS technical studies.
* Support and work on technical and engineering execution of mining projects.
* Support in the maintenance of client relations.
* Site visits and work on sites as required.

**Services will include:**

* Mine planning and design.
* Mining method selection.
* Mine optimization.
* Cost estimates (CAPEX and OPEX)
* Equipment selection.
* Project and study management.
* Due diligence and technical audits.
* Peer reviews.

**What you will bring:**  

**Technical and Industry Experience:**

* Extensive, senior level knowledge and experience in underground consulting and operational excellence
* In\-depth knowledge of Deswik, Studio 5 D planner and other mining industry approved software .
* Experience and strong familiarity with NI43\-101 and/ or JORC compliant studies highly regarded.
* Willingness to travel.
* Proven ability to collaborate in multi\-functional teams.

**Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training:**

**Required:**

* Degree in Engineering.
* PEng valid in Ontario, or ability to obtain.

*For applicants based in the province of Ontario, the salary range is $149,295 to $204,914 CAD.*  

*Application of the pay band: Variation in salary is determined by factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, relevant years of experience, geographic location, internal pay equity, and prevailing market conditions for the specific role.*  

  

*Please note: No agency representation or submissions will be recognized for this vacancy.*  

  

*Worley is committed to providing a fair and equitable hiring process for all applicants. As part of this commitment, Worley will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If you require any accommodations or assistance, please contact us at:* *TA.AMERICAS@worley.com*

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
